description: Nautilus Spiral is an original chambered-nautilus-inspired companion with a striped external shell, speckled hood, lateral eyes, siphon and dense unsuckered tentacle crown. Original bead-fanning, bubble-pulse greeting, seaweed adjustment and three-direction swimming animations. The visible tentacle count and motion are readable artistic adaptations. Original morphology exploration only; no popularity claim.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
